## Teaching and supervision

- **2020–2023** · Teaching Assistant, tutor and lab demonstrator (part-time), University of Canterbury: ANTA102, ANTA201, GEOG312, GEOG323 and GISC406
- **2026** · Delivered two SAR laboratory sessions at the 2nd IEEE GRSS NZ Radar Remote Sensing School, 15–17 April 2026
- Member of the supervisory team of a PhD student studying fast ice and ice shelf interactions in McMurdo Sound
- Helped supervise two MSc students at the Waterways Centre: mapping the Ashley braided river floodplain, and identifying hāpua with a CNN model
- Supervised three honours students working on New Zealand glaciers with SAR data
- **2023** · Mentor, Adopt a Scientist programme, Lincoln High School
